ovl/_engagement (work log 03-04/08) + ha.title: Fiori PR and PO apps: valuation-type defaulting and document-type validations
ovl/_engagement (work log 03-04/08) + ha.req: The Fiori purchase requisition app stopped with 'valuation type should be entered' for split-valuated materials. Document type SWO also needed a mandatory contract, and a blank item category had to be rejected for SEM, SNB, SRC and SWO.
ovl/_engagement (work log 03-04/08) + ha.chal: Classic BAdIs run on the OData path without SY-TCODE or SY-UCOMM, and a GUI-only global variable caused a field-symbol dump when the enhancement ran from Fiori.
ovl/_engagement (work log 03-04/08) + ha.ai: Designed the valuation-type default from MBEW in PROCESS_ITEM for creation only and mirrored it into the PO BAdI. Wrote the SWO contract and item-category checks in CHECK, located and re-guarded the Fiori-path dump, and identified enhancement MM06E005 for the RFQ equivalent.
ovl/_engagement (work log 03-04/08) + ha.man: The consultant implemented the changes in the BAdI implementations and verified the behaviour in the Fiori apps and in SAP GUI with the functional consultant.
ovl/_engagement (work log 03-04/08) + ha.res: Split-valuated materials can be ordered from Fiori without entering a valuation type, and the document-type rules apply in Fiori and in GUI. The Fiori-path dump no longer occurs.

ovl/mm-fiori + work log 10-14/08.title: Five Fiori List Report apps for MM tender reports on one OData service
ovl/mm-fiori + work log 10-14/08.req: The MM tender reports ZMM_TENDER_REG, ZMMTENDERRPT, ZMMTMS and ZMM_VMS were to be offered as Fiori tiles, while the EMD transaction ZMMEMD stays a WebGUI tile.
ovl/mm-fiori + work log 10-14/08.chal: ZMM_TENDER_REG returns three different layouts (22, 38 and 12 columns) by radio button and needs lookups on PA0002, T024 and LFA1, so custom entities with query provider classes were required.
ovl/mm-fiori + work log 10-14/08.ai: Assessed the five transactions for Fiori fit, designed three List Report tiles for the tender register and built the custom entities and query providers, with all CDS objects on a single service definition and binding.
ovl/mm-fiori + work log 10-14/08.man: The consultant validated each tile by exporting the CDS output and comparing it row by row with the GUI report, then took the apps through BTP deployment.
ovl/mm-fiori + work log 10-14/08.res: Five List Report apps run on one service, each reconciled row by row against its GUI report before handover to the functional consultant.

ovl/mm-fiori + work log 10-11/08.title: ZMMEMD EMD management: LOA number in the Change and Display popups with search help
ovl/mm-fiori + work log 10-11/08.req: Users needed to select an EMD by LOA number in the Change and Display popups of the EMD management transaction.
ovl/mm-fiori + work log 10-11/08.chal: The existing search help reads the EMD detail table, not the header that carries the LOA number, so a new elementary search help on the header table was needed.
ovl/mm-fiori + work log 10-11/08.ai: Delivered the LOA number field for both popups with a new elementary search help on the EMD header table, plus four further fixes in the same module pool.
ovl/mm-fiori + work log 10-11/08.man: The consultant created the search help in SE11, applied the screen and code changes in the module pool and tested both popups.
ovl/mm-fiori + work log 10-11/08.res: EMD documents can be found by LOA number in both popups, with F4 help reading the header table.

ovl/ocv-to-ovl-transfer + work log 13-14.title: JV transfer programs: G/L derivation keyed by JV, offset profit centre from mapping
ovl/ocv-to-ovl-transfer + work log 13-14.req: For the Colombia OCV to OVL transfers the receiving G/L had to be derived per joint venture, and the offset profit centre for vendor and G/L offset items was no longer to be hardcoded.
ovl/ocv-to-ovl-transfer + work log 13-14.chal: The derivation runs through five mapping tables on the JV ledger line items (JVSO1, ledgers 4A and 4C), and the same logic exists in more than one program.
ovl/ocv-to-ovl-transfer + work log 13-14.ai: Changed the receiving G/L derivation to sender G/L, company code and JV, moved the offset profit centre to a new PC_DEFAULT field on ZJV_MAP_COCODE, and applied the same mapping logic to ZJV_DOC_TRANSFER and ZOCV_OVL_TRANSFER.
ovl/ocv-to-ovl-transfer + work log 13-14.man: The consultant added the table field in SE11, activated the programs and tested the postings with the functional consultant.
ovl/ocv-to-ovl-transfer + work log 13-14.res: The receiving G/L and the offset profit centre now come from maintained mapping data per venture instead of hardcoded values.

.archive/INBOX_2026-08-23.md + work log.title: ZMM_VMS vendor creation: number-range error in Mock-2 resolved
.archive/INBOX_2026-08-23.md + work log.req: Vendor creation through ZMM_VMS stopped in Mock-2 with 'No number could be determined for number range'.
.archive/INBOX_2026-08-23.md + work log.chal: The behaviour differed between ECC and the converted system, so the number-range determination for the vendor account group had to be traced.
.archive/INBOX_2026-08-23.md + work log.ai: Diagnosed the number-range determination error and supplied the fix, answered the GST vendor classification query and triaged the remaining Mock-2 items into a ranked queue.
.archive/INBOX_2026-08-23.md + work log.man: The consultant applied the fix in the system and followed up the retest with the business user.
.archive/INBOX_2026-08-23.md + work log.res: Vendor creation works again. The fix was confirmed working by the user on 21/08/26.

ovl/atc.title: ATC S/4HANA-readiness remediation of 51 program includes in 14 packages
ovl/atc.objects: 51 includes of 43 programs, for example ZFI_TAX_CREDIT_REPORT, ZFI_VOUCHER_PRINT, MZMMVENDORF01, ZF_FILL_MISSING_AUGGJ_NGLM
ovl/atc.req: The ATC findings on the custom objects assigned for the S/4HANA conversion, 847 findings in all, had to be remediated.
ovl/atc.chal: Findings spanned SELECT SINGLE without a unique key, field-length extension, simplified objects such as BSEG, KONV and VBUK / VBUP, strict Open SQL and pseudo-comment rules, on an older S/4 release.
ovl/atc.ai: Worked the findings family by family: 205 marked correction blocks in 51 includes (107 pseudo-comment, 65 replacements with the original kept commented, 33 new code), 833 lines added or changed. Packaged the includes by package with an upload procedure, a manual review list and a knowledge base of correction patterns.
ovl/atc.man: The consultant agreed the scope with the senior consultant, took the decisions on priority-1 findings, reviewed the corrections with a rule audit across all 51 objects and prepared the handover.
ovl/atc.res: All 847 assigned findings were worked: corrected with documented patterns or routed for decision (26). Original code is kept commented for review and the patterns are reusable.

pal/zsd_fi_sgtxt.title: SD billing: sales order Header Note 1 on the customer line item (INC01740)
pal/zsd_fi_sgtxt.req: The customer line of SD billing documents showed no text in the Fiori Manage Customer Line Items app. The business wanted the sales order Header Note 1 there, as on the Statement of Account.
pal/zsd_fi_sgtxt.chal: The text must be filled at posting time inside an existing exit include whose CHECK statement leaves the exit early for most invoices, and the first-created sales order has to be found from the billing items.
pal/zsd_fi_sgtxt.ai: Chose the SD-FI customer exit over a BTE or the AC_DOCUMENT BAdI with reasons, placed the insert above the existing CHECK, and wrote the first-created-order rule and the READ_TEXT logic with language fallback (include 119 to 221 lines).
pal/zsd_fi_sgtxt.man: The consultant supplied the active include, confirmed text ID 0002 in table TTXIT, applied the change and tested billing documents in the PAL system.
pal/zsd_fi_sgtxt.res: New billing documents carry the Header Note 1 on the customer line, so it shows in the Fiori app with no change to the app or its CDS views.

ovl/f1592_asset_worklist.title: Fiori F1592 Asset Master Worklist: Custodian of Assets via CDS extensions
ovl/f1592_asset_worklist.objects: ZZI_FIXEDASSETWORKLIST_EXT (CDS extend view), ZZC_FIXEDASSETWORKLIST_EXT (CDS extend view)
ovl/f1592_asset_worklist.req: Custodian of Assets and Joint Venture, maintained in the asset master, did not appear in the Fiori asset apps used by Corporate Accounts.
ovl/f1592_asset_worklist.chal: The field sits on ANLU, which the standard view stack does not join, and the consumption view accepts no metadata extension on this release.
ovl/f1592_asset_worklist.ai: Analysed the SAP knowledge-base article and the extensibility routes, then built a modification-free association to ANLU in an interface view extension, carried it up through a consumption view extension and placed the UI annotations inline.
ovl/f1592_asset_worklist.man: The consultant confirmed the field and the view alias in the system, activated the extensions in ADT and cleared the gateway and UI caches.
ovl/f1592_asset_worklist.res: The custodian field is available in the worklist without modifying any standard view.
